objective: Compare the browse and screen capability work against its stated requirements.
scope: Commit ec15538d on release/0.3.1/feat/screen in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-screen (range 3f1c135b..ec15538d), plus merges of the fff branch and the integration branch up to c6a2ac71; source diff without dist at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/screen-commit.diff; writer report /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw9trshx-cnhq.md

Requirements: opencode browse is @opencode/browse (MIT, 0.0.15, stdio MCP server plus a paired Chromium extension driving the user's real browser), registered for Pi at an exact pin moved by deps:update; setup reports when the extension is not installed or paired. Computer use is not a role but a screen capability an Assignment can carry; it grants computer-use tools (pi-computer-use), browser use (opencode browse) and the T3 in-app browser (T3 preview tools where T3 hosts the session), and routes that Assignment to GPT-6.1 Terra whatever its role, at least medium. The screen capabilities are granted per Assignment to keep specialist tool lists small. Capabilities have headless and normal forms: the screen capability uses a headless Playwright Chromium in a cloud or CI session and the paired real browser and desktop computer use on a desktop; setup and doctor detect the system and pick the form, and a capability whose needs are missing is reported, not silently dropped. Everything is modular, can be turned off on its own, with exact pins moved by deps:update.

Known gaps from the writer to judge: no headless Playwright Chromium form was built (browse drives a real browser only); browse 0.0.16 exists, the pin stays at 0.0.15; a second agent file per specialist (<agent>-screen, 36 in all) carries the screen tools; the Claude host refuses screen Assignments; the R-SCREEN requirement was added to the requirements tree and all three families.
constraints: Read-only: no edits, no git writes. Run commands only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-screen and pass the explicit range 3f1c135b..c6a2ac71 to any review command.
Read @opencode/browse 0.0.15 from npm where the integration's assumptions need checking.
Testing is unit tests and fixtures only: never start pi, a browser, the browse server or T3.
Report in under 450 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text, a colon and the support inline.

result:
result: Browse and screen wiring is mostly met by reading. Missing: the headless Playwright form. Partly met: pairing reporting and T3 host gating. Read-only review, no checks run.
changed: none
checks: none run. No shell was available, so no git, mise or bun test. Reviewed the diff file (`/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/screen-commit.diff`) and the worktree files at `/home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-screen`, which may not match c6a2ac71 exactly. Fetched `@opencode/browse` 0.0.15 `package.json` and `skills/browse/SKILL.md` from unpkg; the dist JS was refused by the fetch tool.
blockers: none
questions: The headless Playwright Chromium form is unbuilt, which needs a new dependency. Is it in scope? Is `browserUse` default-on wanted? The requirements do not say.
notes:
- `deps:check` is not in `verify` or CI (`mise.toml` 70-72; no `deps:check` in `.github`), so its exit 1 does not block merge.
- In headless, the specialist agent file still lists `mcp__browse__*` and `computer_use_*` (`tools.ts` `toolArgs` ignores form). `extension.ts` `registerScreen` raises no notice when `screenServers` is empty, so the specialist is not told.
- Unrequested, named by writer or not: 36 `-screen` agent files; `SpecialistEntry.screen` with mismatch and warm-reuse rules (`domain/specialists.ts`, `directive.ts`); Claude-host refusal (`cli/assignment.ts`); T3 preview tools granted without a host check.
evidence:
Each stated requirement for browse and the screen capability is met, partly met or missing, with the code or test that shows it:
  - MIT, 0.0.15, `browse` bin, Node >=22.19, MCP plus extension driving the user's visible browser: verified (unpkg `package.json`, `SKILL.md`). Stdio `mcp` subcommand, `pair --list`, the tokens path and "no launch code": unverified, bundle unreadable.
  - Registered for Pi at an exact pin moved by deps:update: verified. `pi-packages.json` 9543; `capabilities.ts` 386-391 `npx -y @opencode/browse@<pin> mcp`; updater reads and writes the file (`scripts/update-dependencies.ts` 429-452, 711; prerelease excluded).
  - Setup reports when the extension is not installed or paired: partly met. `setup/browse.ts` reads `browser-tokens.json`; `browser-use.ts` 10106-10113 and `pi-check.ts` `checkPairing` give a `~` line on unpaired. Not-installed and not-paired are merged, and the relay's `pairingState` (SKILL.md) is not used.
  - Computer use is a screen capability, not a role, granting computer-use tools: verified. `domain/assignment.ts` 9553-9566; `capabilities.ts` 343; `tools.ts` 9934.
  - Browser use (opencode browse) granted per Assignment: verified. `capabilities.ts` 375; `agents.ts` 8176 passes `mcp__` names.
  - T3 in-app browser "where T3 hosts the session": partly met. `T3_PREVIEW_TOOLS` go to any screen specialist (`capabilities.ts` 317, 375); no host check, so the tools are absent only by accident outside T3.
  - Routes to GPT-6.1 Terra whatever the role, at least medium: verified under Codex only. `codex/routes.ts` 9832-9838 `screenRoute`, `TERRA` 9; wired in `provider.ts` and `cli/config.ts` 9193. Other providers keep the row.
  - Per-Assignment grant keeps tool lists small: verified. `agents.ts` 8191-8246; `route.ts` 9661-9662 `agentFor`.
  - Headless and normal forms; screen uses headless Playwright Chromium in cloud or CI: missing. `capabilities.ts` 330 and 369-372 mark headless unavailable for both computer-use and browse; no Playwright headless dependency.
  - Setup and doctor detect the system and pick the form: verified. `extension.ts` `machineForm` via `detectForm`; `steps.ts` 179-184 pass `form.form`; `pi-check.ts` `checkCapabilities` uses `choice.form`.
  - Unmet needs reported, not silently dropped: partly met. Setup and doctor report them; the specialist side is silent (see notes).
  - Modular, each capability can be turned off alone: verified. `enabledCapabilities` filters by feature (`capabilities.ts` 547); `tools.test.ts` 656 and `screen.test.ts` 36 cover browse off; tests not run.
  - Nothing beyond the requirements was added without being named: not met. See notes; the writer named the second agent file, the Claude refusal and the 36 files, but not the registry, reuse or T3 host behaviours above.
findings: `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/screen-commit.diff` (source sections 8136-8662, 9072-9274, 9274-10279); unpkg `@opencode/browse@0.0.15` `package.json` and `skills/browse/SKILL.md`.

acceptance.rationale: Review evidence holds; findings go to the repair
